AUTHORITY: User-authorized source reconciliation; L1-product/L1.1-feature-catalog.md F-14; L5-verification/backend-frontend-coverage-audit.md; existing packages/db schema/migrations, packages/api media-operation contracts, packages/dashboard media controls and crates/media-plane boundary

COPY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/codex-f14-watermark-policy-source-r9
DELIVERY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/deliveries/codex-f14-watermark-policy-source-r9
COPY_MODE: Fetch and verify SOURCE_COMMIT, then create a new writable isolated copy at COPY_ROOT. Do not use R8/R7 copies, a moving branch tip, stale work directories or any Codex checkout.
SCOPE: Reconcile F-14’s existing Rust watermark primitives with a model-scoped, tenant-safe, persisted watermark policy and accessible dashboard controls without creating parallel media state. Reuse existing org/model/asset/media-operation ownership, RLS, idempotency and approval contracts. Replace caller-supplied untrusted watermark-path behavior with an authorized policy-bound input or an equivalent existing boundary contract; enforce bounded position/opacity/dimensions and safe asset ownership at the existing API/media-plane boundary. Add only the migration/schema source required by the existing DB conventions; source only, never execute migrations. Keep provider, CDN, deployment and runtime acceptance unclaimed.
REQUIRED_SURFACES: API read/write/preview contract with tenant/model authorization and idempotency; dashboard create/edit/enable/disable/preview/error/empty states reachable from existing media controls; Rust-side validation and fail-closed path/policy checks; migration/schema source if the existing architecture requires persistence.
ACCEPTANCE: Tests must cover cross-tenant and cross-model denial, unassigned/unauthorized actor, missing/disabled policy, owned versus foreign watermark asset, path traversal or arbitrary path rejection, invalid position/opacity/dimension bounds, duplicate intent, stale revision, RLS/schema contract and responsive dashboard states. Run focused API/dashboard/Rust/schema tests with real exit codes. DELIVERY must list every changed source/test/migration path with SHA-256, exact commands, exact exits, TEST_RESULT and LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE. Do not claim deployed sidecar, CDN, browser, provider or live migration acceptance.
DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, bridge service implementation, bridge audit task, deployment, live or disposable database, migration execution, providers, OAuth, credentials, permissions, systemd, network, runtime services, publication, billing, external messaging or any path outside COPY_ROOT and DELIVERY_ROOT
LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE
sincerely, Codex
